stem.text: A neutron ${}^{1}_{0}\text{n}$ is fired at a ${}^{235}_{92}\text{U}$ nucleus. The neutron is absorbed by the nucleus which then splits to form nuclei of ${}^{141}_{56}\text{Ba}$ and ${}^{92}_{36}\text{Kr}$.
What is the number of free neutrons emitted when the ${}^{235}_{92}\text{U}$ nucleus splits?
